x: Windley won the Long Jump with 19ft. 5½ins. Windley was also 2nd in the Weight, with R.
We were short of Field Event men for the match but Randy Glenn proved to be the ubiquitious member and seemed never to be without some implement in hand.
R.Harris (scratch) won with a very good out of season putt of 44ft. 3ins. R. Glenn (10ft) beating our other scratch man E.
Javelin- R.Liggins(B) 172'1"; J.Ware(A) 138'10"; Melsh(A) 129'10" Shot- I.Mayers(A) 35'4"; J.Ware(A) 34'3"; R.Glenn(B) 34'2"

After Terry Newell, Randy Glenn and Peter Pepe had run we were abreast of Blackheath, a good 15 yards clear of the remainder. Although he had run a half-mile heat and final during the afternoon, John Thresher took last stage.
Randy Glenn, Terry Newell and Alan Jackson produced a blanket finish for 2nd, 3rd and 4th, all recording 51.5. The hardest fought race of the day was the Senior 880 yards.
